entities.summary:
France is a sovereign nation in Western Europe, Europe. Its capital is Paris. Official languages include French. Government: Unitary semi-presidential constitutional republic. Population: approximately 68.4 million. Area: 640,679 km². Comprehensive index for France covering Gaul (Vercingetorix, Caesar's conquest 52 BCE), Frankish kingdoms (Clovis I 481, Merovingians, Carolingians), Charlemagne (Holy Roman Emperor 800), Capetian dynasty, Hundred Years' War (1337-1453, Joan of Arc), Renaissance, Wars of Religion (St.

Bartholomew's Day Massacre 1572), Louis XIV Sun King (Versailles, absolute monarchy), French Revolution 1789 (storming Bastille, Declaration of Rights, Terror, Robespierre), Napoleon Bonaparte (Emperor 1804-15, Napoleonic Wars, Code Napoleon), Restoration/July Revolution 1830/1848 Revolution, Second Empire (Napoleon III), Franco-Prussian War 1870, Third Republic, Dreyfus Affair, WWI (Verdun, 1.4M dead), WWII (Fall of France 1940, Vichy regime, Free France/de Gaulle, D-Day liberation), Fourth Republic, Algerian War (1954-62), Fifth Republic (de Gaulle), May 1968, EU founding member, and cultural superpower.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: France's impact on European history is profound, with its influence extending to the Napoleonic Wars and shaping the course of modern politics through the French Revolution. The country's population has remained relatively stable at around 68 million since the late 19th century.
